description: Advanced Features - Enable complex workflows and integrations

userStories.title: File Operations
userStories.description: As a user, I need file operations (open, save, export) so that I can manage documents via MCP.
acceptanceCriteria: export_file tool exports to common formats (STEP, IGES, DWG)
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10: 3 Python tools, 1 C# handler, 12 tests

userStories.title: Viewport Control
userStories.description: As a user, I need viewport controls so that I can set views, zoom, and navigate programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria: set_view tool sets named views (Top, Front, Perspective, etc.)
capture_viewport tool captures viewport as image
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10: 4 Python tools, 1 C# handler, 17 tests

userStories.title: Groups & Blocks
userStories.description: As a user, I need group and block operations so that I can organize and reuse geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: create_group tool groups objects by ID
explode_block tool converts block to geometry
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10: 5 Python tools, 1 C# handler with RunScript, tests created

userStories.title: Mesh Import/Export
userStories.description: As a user, I need mesh I/O so that I can import/export OBJ, STL, and 3MF files.
acceptanceCriteria: export_mesh tool exports to OBJ, STL, 3MF
mesh_from_brep tool converts Brep to mesh
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10: 3 Python tools, 1 C# handler, 12 tests

userStories.title: Render Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I need render settings so that I can configure camera, lighting, and presets.
acceptanceCriteria: render_view tool renders current view to image
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10: 4 Python tools, 1 C# handler, 20 tests

userStories.title: Grasshopper Integration
userStories.description: As a user, I need Grasshopper integration so that I can evaluate definitions and bake geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: bake_grasshopper tool bakes output to Rhino
userStories.notes: Most complex - requires Grasshopper API. Consider splitting into sub-stories.
